items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Slim and Lemon Slam used to work there with us.

ctx.x: But the big thing was that Lunceford Luntz was in town, and Duke was in town, because Duke was in town because he was doing downtown the show which ran quite a while. They got 5 or 6 men from each one of their bands, and then the trios would play, and then we would close it, you know. And naturally, it was kind of a mismatch, because we would burn them up -- because we had all these arrangements, you know, and they were from a big band and we were from a small band.

Then we went to Cafe Society -- and we stayed at Cafe Society I think for 3 months. Wait a second. No, I missed a point in there ... because before we went back to New York, Billy Berg had had another club, and that club was -- oh, incidentally, what I missed over at Billy Berg's -- Slim and Lemon Slam used to work there with us. I think that would be interesting to you.
